name: 22039 · Fairfax Sta, VA
findings: ZIP 22039 (Fairfax Sta) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22039 (Fairfax Sta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22039 (Fairfax Sta) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
